table.breakroom.weird_events.text: Someone microwaves fish. Everyone becomes worse.
The Wetberry label turns one degree toward the cleric.
A passive-aggressive note appears: PLEASE CLEAN UP AFTER YOUR SUMMONINGS.
The coffee maker produces prophecy and a small amount of burnt sludge.

table.breakroom.loot.text: A rumor that grows stronger every time it is repeated

table.act2.fridge_weird_events.text: A jar spontaneously opens and releases a cloud of blue cheese mist.
The ancient mayonnaise hums and tells you a story about itself.
A voice whispers from the yogurt catacombs: 'Thank you for the offering.'
The Fridge of Forgotten Things adjusts itself, revealing new shelves.

table.act2.moldric_quotes.text: 'All things must be preserved, even memories.'
'The back shelf is where the truly forgotten things live.'
'Every good lunch deserves its own tomb.'
'Mayonnaise is not just food. It's memory crystallized.'

table.act4.labyrinth_weird_events.text: A forgotten yogurt cup rolls across the path, whispering 'Choose me next time.'
The walls pulse with the memory of a thousand abandoned potlucks.
A ghostly fork floats past, still carrying a phantom olive.
The air smells faintly of someone else's meal prep from 2012.

table.act4.moldric_guide_quotes.text: 'Every container here was opened with hope and closed with regret.'
'The labyrinth does not forgive. But it does remember. That is worse.'
'I once ruled the back shelf. Now I guide the lost through the fridge-space.'
'The Casserole Throne awaits. It has been waiting since the potluck of 2007.'

table.system.containment_aftershocks.text: The bag emits one offended crinkle. Moisture pressure drops another notch.
A tiny HR barcode appears on the bag. Bureaucracy approves despite itself.
Wetberry rotates inside the sealed bag exactly one degree toward the nearest refrigerator.

table.system.hearing_reactions.text: A court printer ejects a page reading OBJECTION REGISTERED, SOMEHOW.
Gorrum coughs into one fist to hide what may have been a laugh.
The arena lights flare green. The room has interpreted the slap as precedent.
